A lists of spells available to be prepared by the wizard class.

Overview

Wizard spells are prepared spells, and must be prepared by the wizard out of the spells in their spellbook. Unlike other classes that use prepared spells, wizards don't gain access to all wizard spells automatically. They select 6 spells to learn initially, and can only learn an additional 2 on each level up. Outside of that, they must transcribe spells into their spellbook by using scrolls. In exchange, the wizard spell list is considerably larger than other classes.

Wizard spells will use the caster's Intelligence modifier for Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.
